entities.summary: Andrei Andreyevich Mironov is a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently under contract to Spartak Moscow of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Colorado Avalanche, 101st overall, in the 2015 NHL Entry Draft.
